summary: Two narrow fixes from T77 live evidence: surface real exception codes from execute_tool (NotFoundError was masked as invalid_output) and harden the advance_lesson trigger instruction plus question_id provenance guidance.
final_report:
T77-Fix done — both evidence links fixed, compileall clean, pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py -q 18/18 green, no commit (batch rule).

(1) Code surfacing, app/llm/tools.py:
- grade_answer tool description now ends with: 'question_id MUST be copied VERBATIM from the ids returned by run_probe (opaque hex strings like 9f2c…, NEVER display numbers like 1 or 2).'
- _issue_code now surfaces exception-borne codes: after the existing detail-issue_codes / pydantic / 'Empty model output' branches it checks getattr(exc, 'code', None) and returns any non-empty string as-is, so NotFoundError('question', <bad id>) from LearningService.answer_quiz now yields {"error": "not_found"} to the model instead of masked invalid_output; ProviderError codes (timeout/rate_limit/...) surface the same way. 'not_found' added to _KNOWN_ERROR_CODES. Deliberate ordering deviation from the brief's literal 'first check': a truly-first exc.code check would remap ModelOutputError('Empty model output…') from empty_output to its class code 'model_output' and break the existing repair-loop behavior/test (ModelOutputError carries class attr code='model_output'); NotFoundError hits none of the earlier branches so it still lands on the new check. Existing mappings fully preserved.
- _run_probe return payload extended with "grading_hint": "Grade replies with grade_answer using these exact question_id values." so id provenance rides along with every probe result.

(2) Trigger hardening, app/llm/messages.py PHASE_PLAYBOOK teach section: soft sentence replaced with the brief's procedural imperative verbatim ('Grading: call grade_answer passing question_id EXACTLY as returned by run_probe. The moment the learner's answer grades correct — or they say they've got it / ask to move on — call advance_lesson{passed_check:true} IN THAT SAME REPLY before writing any teaching prose. If their answer grades incorrect, remediate first without advancing.')

(3) Test, tests/test_tools_loop.py: added test_execute_tool_grade_answer_unknown_question_surfaces_not_found — runs a real run_probe through LearningService, asserts the grading_hint field, then grades an unknown uuid id and asserts execute_tool returns exactly {"error": "not_found"} (real production exception path, not a stubbed raise).

Verification performed: python -m compileall clean on all three files; python -m pytest tests/test_tools_loop.py -q → 18 passed in 2.49s (17 pre-existing + 1 new). Full-suite run and live-server re-drive of the Socratic arc remain for Merlin (verification marked analyzer_pending per brief); server auto-reload picks the changes up live.
